source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 DLRM v2 99.9 high-accuracy Offline and compare it with MLCommons v4.0 results.
procedure_facts: The text then asks for a valid BERT result and the Script field points to a Llama2-70B 99.9 repository.
criteria_facts: Greater than an unspecified official NVIDIA MLPerf score.
source_conflicts: DLRM v2 conflicts with BERT and the Llama2 Script path.
The generic NVIDIA score has no matching hardware/system/configuration identity.
missing_source_information: Pinned v4.0 DLRM high-accuracy artifacts and configs.
Accuracy/compliance phases and comparable Offline result ID.
Numeric samples/s comparison rule and platform limits.

original_test_intent.statement: Run a valid MLPerf Inference v4.0 DLRM v2 99.9 high-accuracy Offline benchmark, prove high-accuracy and LoadGen/compliance validity, and compare Offline samples/s with a signed comparable v4.0 result.
must_preserve: Offline scenario and its throughput metric.
must_not_infer: DLRM 99 normal accuracy, Server latency semantics, BERT or Llama2.
Official submission status from a local run.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 preserves DLRM 99.9 Offline and calls for high-accuracy model/data/calibration plus valid LoadGen evidence.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 catches BERT but not the contradictory Llama2 Script field, and it does not define Offline-specific samples/s comparison against an identified equivalent result.

related_records: The DLRM 99 Server row is not interchangeable: this row is 99.9 high-accuracy Offline.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The title and explicit arguments govern; BERT/Llama references are source defects requiring correction.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Execution waits for DLRM/BERT/Llama correction, pinned high-accuracy artifacts and a comparable Offline reference. Once supplied, the harness phases are automatable under approved GPU-load controls.

conditions_present: Title and run arguments agree on DLRM v2, Offline and high_accuracy.
missing: Correct script, artifact hashes/licenses, system/user/mlperf configs, accuracy/compliance procedure, comparable result and thresholds.
provider: Benchmark owner corrects references and signs comparison.
Platform owner approves tuning and thermal/power limits.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory GPU/CPU/topology/driver/runtime/storage and inspect manifests/published result metadata.
prohibited_until_resolved: Artifact download, container/tuning changes, workload, log clearing or PASS.
closure_evidence: Corrected DLRM-only source and pinned v4.0 stack.
Comparable Offline result ID and numeric rule.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 DLRM v2 99.9 Offline
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v4.0 DLRM v2 high-accuracy Offline configuration, verify the 99.9 accuracy requirement plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure Offline samples per second, and compare only with a signed comparable v4.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SUT system ID, GPU/CPU/memory/topology, driver/runtime, container/harness commit, DLRM v2 model, Multihot Criteo data/preprocessing and v4.0 rule/config files. Vendor implementations are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All resources declared by the system configuration; DLRM v2 99.9 high_accuracy; Offline only. Server, BERT, Llama2 and normal-accuracy profiles are excluded.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected source; pinned v4.0 harness/container; licensed model/data/calibration and hashes; system/user/mlperf configs; AccuracyOnly, PerformanceOnly and compliance procedures; approved tuning/power/cooling; comparable published Offline result ID; samples/s tolerance, validity and health limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify hashes/configs and baseline health, then execute DLRM v2 high-accuracy Offline accuracy, performance and required compliance phases exactly as the pinned v4.0 implementation specifies. Preserve raw LoadGen logs, configs and telemetry. Do not run the BERT criterion, Llama script, Server mode or generic command until compatibility is proven.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflicts resolved; licensed pinned artifacts; full GPU visibility; adequate storage/cooling/power; approved tuning and recovery; no competing GPU workload.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/config identity; GPU UUID/BDF/topology; driver/runtime/container/harness/model/data hashes; exact commands and configs; DLRM high-accuracy result; complete LoadGen accuracy/detail/summary logs; valid Offline samples/s; required compliance output; power/thermal/XID/ECC/host logs; matching reference ID and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v4.0 DLRM v2 99.9 Offline rules plus the identified comparable result. Pass requires 99.9 accuracy validity, valid LoadGen/compliance, samples/s meeting the signed comparison and no disallowed platform errors. Server latency or a normal-accuracy result cannot substitute.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix 99/99.9, Server/Offline, models/releases/vendors; use unlicensed artifacts; copy unmatched tuning; alter clocks/power/cooling without approval; suppress invalid results; clear logs; or call a local run official.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/software/platform owners approve model, artifacts, comparison, tuning and sustained load; a human judges comparability and PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans resolve conflicts and comparison validity. The Agent executes only the pinned DLRM 99.9 Offline workflow and cannot waive accuracy/compliance.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity or limits, preserve logs, terminate cleanly, restore tuning/services and verify GPU/host health before any approved rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong model/scenario/accuracy/release; unresolved Script/criterion conflict; missing license/config/reference; LoadGen accuracy/validity/compliance failure; topology drift; XID/ECC/thermal/power/storage/host limit; monitoring or evidence loss.

identified_defects: BERT statement and Llama Script contradict DLRM.
Generic score fails to identify comparable Offline hardware/config.
Offline samples/s and high-accuracy evidence are not explicit in source acceptance.
reason_for_change: Protect the high-accuracy Offline semantics and prevent reuse of Server/normal-accuracy or wrong-model evidence.

new_technical_evidence.title: MLPerf Inference reference implementations
new_technical_evidence.supports: DLRM v2 uses the Multihot Criteo dataset and is a v4.0 datacenter benchmark; scenario and release-specific artifacts must match.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact implementation commit and reference result are absent.

new_technical_evidence.title: MLPerf Compatibility Table
new_technical_evidence.supports: Offline and Server report different primary performance metrics; Offline uses samples/s while Server uses queries/s.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The testcase's threshold is not provided.

new_technical_evidence.supports: DLRM v2 99.9 Offline/high_accuracy intent and contradictory references.
